entries.english: What kind of person are you, to be\ndrawn to a barren area like this?
entries.french_reference: Quel genre de personne vient\ns'attirer ici, dans ce désert ?
entries.portuguese: Que tipo de pessoa é você, para\nvir a um lugar tão desolado?

entries.english: It was a strong Trainer who was\ndrawn to this barren area!
entries.french_reference: C'était un Dresseur fort qui\nétait attiré par ce désert !
entries.portuguese: Foi um Treinador forte que veio\na este lugar desolado!

entries.english: I came here in hopes of bringing\nnew life into the area.
entries.french_reference: Je suis venu ici dans l'espoir de\nredonner vie à la région.
entries.portuguese: Vim na esperança de trazer vida\nnova a este lugar.

entries.english:
I've been instructed by my
superiors to hand out that HM to<0xFA>any Trainers coming this way.<0xFB>Until the bridge is fixed, you'll
need to use that HM for <0xFC>ÀÉRock Climb<0xFC>ÀË<0xFA>if you want to go to <0xFC>ÀÉSeaport City<0xFC>ÀË.<0xFB>Just face that rock wall over
there to use it.
entries.french_reference:
Mes supérieurs m'ont chargé de
remettre cette CS à tous les\lDresseurs qui passent par ici.\pTant que le pont n'est pas réparé,
tu devras utiliser la CS <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Escalade<0xFC><0x01><0x08>\lpour aller à <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Naville<0xFC><0x01><0x08>.\pPlace-toi face à cette paroi
rocheuse pour l'utiliser.
entries.portuguese:
Meus superiores mandaram
entregar este HM a todos os<0xFA>Treinadores que passarem aqui.<0xFB>Até a ponte ser consertada, use
este HM: <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Rock Climb<0xFC><0x01><0x08><0xFA>para ir a <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Seaport City<0xFC><0x01><0x08>.<0xFB>Para usá-lo, fique de frente
para aquela parede de pedra.

entries.english:
Sorry, kid!<0xFB>A fight between some Zangoose and
Seviper took out the bridge.<0xFB>It'll take some time before we get
it fixed.<0xFB>You should talk to our boss about
finding an alternative way to<0xFA>Seaport City in the meantime.
entries.french_reference:
Désolé, petit !\pUne bagarre entre des Mangriff et
Séviper a détruit le pont.\pÇa prendra du temps pour le
réparer.\pTu devrais parler à notre chef pour
trouver un autre moyen d'aller à\lNaville en attendant.
entries.portuguese:
Desculpe, criança!<0xFB>Uma briga entre Zangoose e
Seviper destruiu a ponte.<0xFB>Vai demorar um pouco para
consertá-la.<0xFB>Enquanto isso, fale com nosso
chefe para achar outro caminho<0xFA>até Seaport City.

entries.english: It's a seashell.
entries.french_reference: C'est un coquillage.
entries.portuguese: É uma concha.

entries.french_reference: Le {STR_VAR_1} s'est enfoncé dans\nle sable.
entries.portuguese: O <0xFD><0x02> se escondeu na\nareia.

entries.english:
He ho!
You thaved me!<0xFB>I wath looking for Berrieth on behalf
of Tropiuth Berrieth Inc., when all<0xFA>of a thudden theth boulderth fell<0xFA>down around me!<0xFB>But you rethcued me, tho now I can
go home for the day!<0xFB>Becauth of your heroic efforth, I
want you to take thome Berrieth!
entries.french_reference:
Hé ho !
Tu m'as chauvé !\pJe ramachais des Baies pour
Tropius Berries Inc., quand ches\lrochers chont tombés tout autour\lde moi d'un coup !\pMais tu m'as chauvé, alors je
peux rentrer chez moi !\pPour tes efforts héroïques, je
veux te donner des Baies !
entries.portuguese:
Ê, ô! Voxê me xalvou!<0xFB>Eu buxcava Berriex para a
Tropius Berries Inc., quando<0xFA>extax pedrax caíram<0xFA>ao meu redor!<0xFB>Max voxê me xalvou, então poxo
voltar para caxa por hoje!<0xFB>Por xeu exforço heroico, quero
que fique com algumax Berriex!

entries.english: He ho!<0xFB>I'll be back tomorrow to look for\nmore Berrieth!
entries.french_reference: He ho !\pJe reviendrai demain chercher\nplus de Berrieth !
entries.portuguese: Ê, ô!<0xFB>Amanhã volto para buxcar maix\nBerriex!

entries.english: Unfortunately for you, I also require\nthe defeat of all Trainers on this<0xFA>route before I will battle you.<0xFB>Please return once you have done so,\nand then we can begin our eloquent<0xFA>aerial battle!
entries.french_reference: Malheureusement pour toi, tu dois\nbattre tous les Dresseurs de\lcette route avant que je t'affronte.\pReviens une fois que ce sera fait,\net nous pourrons lancer notre\lélégant duel aérien !
entries.portuguese: Infelizmente, também exijo que\nvença todos os Treinadores<0xFA>da rota antes de me enfrentar.<0xFB>Volte quando conseguir, e\npoderemos iniciar nossa<0xFA>eloquente batalha aérea!

entries.english: Today appears to be my lucky day.\nLet us battle!
entries.french_reference: On dirait que c'est mon jour de\nchance. Battons-nous !
entries.portuguese: Parece ser meu dia de sorte.\nVamos batalhar!

entries.english: A shame.\nThat is indeed unfortunate.
entries.french_reference: Quel dommage.\nC'est vraiment regrettable.
entries.portuguese: Que pena. É mesmo lamentável.

entries.english: You are truly an aerial expert.
entries.french_reference: Tu es vraiment un as des airs.
entries.portuguese: Você é um verdadeiro\nespecialista aéreo.

entries.english: You have no Pokémon I would be\nwilling to fight.<0xFB>Only <0xFC>ÀÉFlying<0xFC>ÀË-type Pokémon or\nPokémon with the <0xFC>ÀÉLevitate<0xFC>ÀË ability<0xFA>may battle with my Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Tu n'as aucun Pokémon que j'accepte\nd'affronter.\pSeuls les Pokémon de type {COLOR}ÉVol{COLOR}Ë ou\nceux avec le Talent {COLOR}ÉLévitation{COLOR}Ë\lpeuvent se battre contre les miens.
entries.portuguese: Você não tem Pokémon que eu\nesteja disposto a enfrentar.<0xFB>Só Pokémon do tipo <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Voador<0xFC><0x01><0x08> ou\ncom a Habilidade <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Levitate<0xFC><0x01><0x08><0xFA>podem lutar contra os meus.

entries.english: Our aerial battle brought such joy\nto my heart.<0xFB>Please, take this Mega Stone for the\nPokémon <0xFC>ÀÉPidgeot<0xFC>ÀË as a show of my<0xFA>gratitude!
entries.french_reference: Notre combat aérien m'a comblé de\njoie.\pPrends cette Méga-Gemme pour\n{COLOR}ÉRoucarnage{COLOR}Ë\len guise de remerciement !
entries.portuguese: Nossa batalha aérea trouxe\ntanta alegria ao meu coração.<0xFB>Aceite esta Mega Stone para o\nPokémon <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Pidgeot<0xFC><0x01><0x08> como sinal<0xFA>da minha gratidão!

entries.english: Our aerial battle brought such joy\nto my heart.<0xFB>Please, take these Wings as a show\nof my gratitude!
entries.french_reference: Notre combat aérien a empli mon\ncoeur de joie.\pJe t'en prie, accepte ces Ailes en\ngage de ma gratitude !
entries.portuguese: Nossa batalha aérea trouxe\ntanta alegria ao meu coração.<0xFB>Aceite estas Wings como sinal da\nminha gratidão!

entries.english: tle brought such joy\nto my heart.<0xFB>Please, take these Wings as a show\nof my gratitude!
entries.french_reference: …combat m'a apporté tant\nde joie.\pAccepte ces Ailes en gage\nde ma gratitude !

entries.english: A shame.\nYou don't have space for any wings.
entries.french_reference: Quel dommage.\nTu n'as pas de place pour des ailes.
entries.portuguese: Que pena. Você não tem espaço\npara Wings.

entries.english: Our aerial battle filled me with\nso much joy!<0xFB>Let us do it again tomorrow.
entries.french_reference: Notre combat aérien m'a rempli\nde joie !\pRemettons ça demain.
entries.portuguese: Nossa batalha aérea me encheu\nde alegria!<0xFB>Vamos repetir amanhã.

entries.english: Fishing is a loner's sport.
entries.french_reference: La pêche est un sport de solitaire.
entries.portuguese: Pescar é um esporte solitário.

entries.english: Only a loner could blow off a loss\nlike that.
entries.french_reference: Seul un solitaire peut oublier\nune défaite pareille.
entries.portuguese: Só um solitário aceitaria uma\nderrota dessas numa boa.

entries.english: I try not to leave the area so my\nfishing chain will grow as long as<0xFA>possible.
entries.french_reference: J'essaie de ne pas quitter la zone\npour que ma chaîne de pêche soit\laussi longue que possible.
entries.portuguese: Tento não sair daqui para\nprolongar ao máximo minha<0xFA>sequência de pesca.

entries.english: Most of my friends came to Seaport\nCity from far away regions.
entries.french_reference: La plupart de mes amis sont venus à\nNaville en venant de loin.
entries.portuguese: Quase todos meus amigos vieram\nde longe a Seaport City.

entries.english: But then most of my friends went\nback to where they came from"
entries.french_reference: Mais la plupart sont repartis\nd'où ils venaient…
entries.portuguese: Mas a maioria dos meus amigos\nvoltou para sua terra natal<0xB0>

entries.english: Actually, that guy over there is my\nonly friend now"
entries.french_reference: En fait, ce type là-bas est mon\nseul ami maintenant…
entries.portuguese: Na verdade, aquele cara ali é\nmeu único amigo agora<0xB0>

entries.english: I came here from far away to fish\nfor new Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Je suis venu de loin pour pêcher de\nnouveaux Pokémon.
entries.portuguese: Vim de longe para pescar novos\nPokémon.

entries.english: Were my travels in vain?
entries.french_reference: Mes voyages étaient-ils vains ?
entries.portuguese: Minha viagem foi em vão?

entries.english: I should go back home.<0xFB>There was much more variety in\nwatery areas where I came from.
entries.french_reference: Je devrais rentrer chez moi.\pIl y avait bien plus de variété\nlà d'où je viens, près de l'eau.
entries.portuguese: Devo voltar para casa.<0xFB>Havia muito mais variedade nas\náguas de onde eu vim.

entries.english: Notice the cliffs here"<0xFB>This is the only place in Borrius\nwhere they're this vertical!
entries.french_reference: Regarde ces falaises ici…\pC'est le seul endroit à Borrius\noù elles sont si abruptes !
entries.portuguese: Veja os penhascos daqui<0xB0><0xFB>É o único lugar de Borrius onde\neles são tão verticais!

entries.english: All the more fun to climb!
entries.french_reference: Encore plus amusant à escalader !
entries.portuguese: Assim é mais divertido escalar!

entries.english: When I climb down the bluffs, I\nfind very interesting things hidden<0xFA>in the seashells on the beach!
entries.french_reference: Quand je descends les falaises,\nje trouve des trésors cachés\ldans les coquillages de la plage !
entries.portuguese: Quando desço as falésias, acho\ncoisas muito interessantes nas<0xFA>conchas da praia!

entries.english: My Pokémon were very hard to\nfind.<0xFB>They only appear in the wild for\none hour each day.
entries.french_reference: Mes Pokémon étaient très durs à\ntrouver.\pIls n'apparaissent qu'une heure\npar jour.
entries.portuguese: Foi muito difícil encontrar meus\nPokémon.<0xFB>Eles só aparecem na natureza\npor uma hora a cada dia.

entries.english: It seems rarity does not indicate\nexceptional strength.
entries.french_reference: On dirait que la rareté\nn'indique pas la force.
entries.portuguese: Parece que raridade não\nsignifica força excepcional.

entries.english: Finding rare Pokémon is much\neasier if you have a DexNav.<0xFB>As long as you've seen the\nPokémon, it's very easy to<0xFA>encounter it again!
entries.french_reference: Trouver des Pokémon rares est plus\nsimple avec un DexNav.\pQuand tu as déjà vu un Pokémon,\nc'est facile\lde le recroiser !
entries.portuguese: Encontrar Pokémon raros é bem\nmais fácil com um DexNav.<0xFB>Desde que já tenha visto o\nPokémon, é muito fácil<0xFA>encontrá-lo de novo!

entries.english: My Pokémon and I have been\nrunning across Borrius.<0xFB>We can take a kid Trainer like you!
entries.french_reference: Mes Pokémon et moi avons couru\nà travers Borrius.\pOn peut battre un petit Dresseur\ncomme toi !
entries.portuguese: Meus Pokémon e eu temos corrido\npor toda Borrius.<0xFB>Podemos enfrentar uma criança\nTreinadora como você!

entries.english: I guess we need to run less and\ntrain more"
entries.french_reference: On dirait qu'on doit moins courir\net plus s'entraîner…
entries.portuguese: Acho que precisamos correr\nmenos e treinar mais<0xB0>

entries.english: Huff" Puff"<0xFB>Jogging and battling make a tiring\ncombo!
entries.french_reference: Haa… Haa…\pJogging et combat,\nça fatigue !
entries.portuguese: Ufa<0xB0> Arf<0xB0><0xFB>Correr e batalhar é uma\ncombinação cansativa!

entries.english: Zangoose and Seviper around\nhere always fight each other.
entries.french_reference: Mangriff et Séviper se battent\ntoujours par ici.
entries.portuguese: Os Zangoose e Seviper daqui\nvivem brigando entre si.

entries.english: They fight just like you do!
entries.french_reference: Ils se battent comme toi !
entries.portuguese: Eles brigam como você!

entries.english: I trained my Zangoose and Seviper\nto play together nicely!
entries.french_reference: J'ai entraîné mon Mangriff et mon\nSéviper à bien jouer ensemble !
entries.portuguese: Treinei meu Zangoose e Seviper\npara brincarem em paz!

entries.english: Huh?\nWhat's that?<0xFB>You say there are no Bug Pokémon\naround here?
entries.french_reference: Hein ?\nComment ça ?\pTu dis qu'il n'y a pas de Pokémon\nInsecte ici ?
entries.portuguese: Hã? O que foi?<0xFB>Você diz que não há Pokémon\nInseto por aqui?

entries.english: Huh?\nWhat's that?<0xFB>Then where'd I get my Bug Pokémon\nfrom?
entries.french_reference: Hein ?\nComment ça ?\pAlors d'où vient mon Pokémon\nInsecte ?
entries.portuguese: Hã? O que foi?<0xFB>Então de onde vieram meus\nPokémon Inseto?

entries.english: I know there are bug Pokémon\naround here!<0xFB>There was one day I saw a huge\n<0xFC>ÀÉswarm<0xFC>ÀË of them flying around!
entries.french_reference: Je sais qu'il y a des Pokémon\nInsecte par ici !\pUn jour, j'ai vu un énorme\n{COLOR}Éessaim{COLOR}Ë voler dans le coin !
entries.portuguese: Sei que há Pokémon Inseto por\naqui!<0xFB>Um dia, vi um enorme <0xFC><0x01><0x06>enxame<0xFC><0x01><0x08>\ndeles voando pela área!

entries.english: The more I run, the closer my\nbabies get to me!
entries.french_reference: Plus je cours, plus mes bébés se\nrapprochent de moi !
entries.portuguese: Quanto mais corro, mais meus\nbebês se apegam a mim!

entries.english: Wah!<0xFB>Now they're not as close anymore!
entries.french_reference: Ouin !\pMaintenant ils sont moins proches !
entries.portuguese: Buá!<0xFB>Agora não somos tão próximos!

entries.english: One day, my babies will use a\npowerful Return and beat you up<0xFA>for what you did to them!
entries.french_reference: Un jour, mes bébés lanceront un\nRetour puissant et te feront payer\lce que tu leur as fait !
entries.portuguese: Um dia, meus bebês usarão um\nReturn poderoso para se vingar<0xFA>do que você fez com eles!

entries.portuguese: Route 18

entries.english: I'm swimming to the Pokémon\nLeague.<0xFB>Where are you swimming to?
entries.french_reference: Je nage vers la Ligue\nPokémon.\pTu nages vers où, toi ?
entries.portuguese: Estou nadando até a Liga\nPokémon.<0xFB>Para onde você está nadando?

entries.english: Are you swimming to the Pokémon\nLeague, too?
entries.french_reference: Toi aussi tu nages vers la Ligue\nPokémon ?
entries.portuguese: Também está nadando até a Liga\nPokémon?

entries.english: Let's have a race!<0xFB>Let's see who can get to the\nPokémon League first!
entries.french_reference: On fait la course ?\pVoyons qui atteindra la Ligue\nPokémon en premier !
entries.portuguese: Vamos apostar corrida!<0xFB>Vamos ver quem chega primeiro à\nLiga Pokémon!

entries.english: I've been swimming since I was a\nwee tot, but nothing could have<0xFA>prepared me for this moment.
entries.french_reference: Je nage depuis tout petit, mais\nrien ne pouvait me préparer\là ce moment.
entries.portuguese: Nado desde bem pequeno, mas\nnada poderia ter me preparado<0xFA>para este momento.

entries.english: It was the moment I met you!
entries.french_reference: C'était le moment où je t'ai vu !
entries.portuguese: O momento em que conheci você!

entries.english:
Despite swimming since I was a wee
tot, I had never seen a Trainer<0xFA>riding on the back of a Pokémon<0xFA>before I battled you.<0xFB>Which Pokémon is that you're
Surfing on, anyway?<0xFB>Is that a Wailmer?
It sure looks like one!
entries.french_reference:
Bien que je nage depuis ma plus
tendre enfance, je n'avais jamais\lvu un Dresseur sur le dos d'un\lPokémon avant notre combat.\pSur quel Pokémon surfes-tu,
au juste ?\pC'est un Wailmer ?
On dirait bien en tout cas !
entries.portuguese: Apesar de nadar desde pequeno,\nnunca tinha visto um Treinador<0xFA>montado num Pokémon<0xFA>antes de enfrentar você.<0xFB>Aliás, em qual Pokémon você\nestá usando Surf?<0xFB>É um Wailmer? Parece mesmo!

entries.english: If I'm wearing swim trunks"\nwhere do I put my Poké Balls?<0xFB>Uhh" that's a secret!
entries.french_reference: Si je porte un maillot de bain…\nje mets mes Poké Balls où ?\pEuh… c'est un secret !
entries.portuguese: Se estou de sunga<0xB0> onde guardo\nminhas Poké Balls?<0xFB>Ah<0xB0> isso é segredo!

entries.english: Fine, I'll tell you my secret.
entries.french_reference: Bon, je vais te dire mon secret.
entries.portuguese: Tá bom, vou contar meu segredo.

entries.english: I keep my Poké Balls in the\npockets of my swim trunks.<0xFB>"<0xFB>What?\nExpecting a different answer?
entries.french_reference: Je garde mes Poké Balls dans les\npoches de mon maillot.\p…\pQuoi ?\nTu attendais autre chose ?
entries.portuguese: Guardo minhas Poké Balls nos\nbolsos da sunga.<0xFB><0xB0><0xFB>O quê? Esperava outra resposta?

entries.english: Only the best swimmers can swim all\nthe way to the Pokémon League!
entries.french_reference: Seuls les meilleurs nageurs peuvent\naller jusqu'à la Ligue Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Só os melhores nadadores chegam\nà Liga Pokémon!

entries.english: You're cheating!
entries.french_reference: Tu triches !
entries.portuguese: Você está trapaceando!

entries.english: It defeats the purpose of swimming\nacross a long watery stretch if<0xFA>your Pokémon does it for you!
entries.french_reference: Traverser une longue étendue d'eau\nà la nage n'a aucun sens si ton\lPokémon le fait à ta place !
entries.portuguese: Não faz sentido atravessar tanta\nágua a nado se o seu<0xFA>Pokémon faz isso por você!

entries.english: With the power of my mind"<0xFB>I will throw sand in your face!\nTime to attack, my Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: Par la puissance de mon esprit…\pJe vais te lancer du sable au nez !\nÀ l'attaque, mes Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Com o poder da minha mente<0xB0><0xFB>Vou jogar areia na sua cara!\nHora de atacar, meu Pokémon!

entries.english: The sand didn't lower your\nAccuracy"
entries.french_reference: Le sable n'a pas baissé ta\nPrécision…
entries.portuguese: A areia não reduziu sua\nPrecisão<0xB0>

entries.english: My Pokémon doesn't know Sand-\nAttack, but I can always help<0xFA>out using my psychic abilities!
entries.french_reference: Mon Pokémon ne connaît pas\nJet-Sable, mais je peux toujours\laider avec mes pouvoirs psychiques !
entries.portuguese: Meu Pokémon não sabe\nSand-Attack, mas posso ajudar<0xFA>com meus poderes psíquicos!

entries.english: You see that man on the other\nbeach?<0xFB>He's my rival!
entries.french_reference: Tu vois cet homme sur l'autre\nplage ?\pC'est mon rival !

entries.english:
Do you know about the
Hall of Fame?<0xFB>It's the place where you go if you
defeat the Pokémon League!<0xFB>At one point, the old Champion,
Artie had been there so many times,<0xFA>he decided to set a goal of going<0xFA>there with every team consisting<0xFA>of a common type.<0xFB>Sadly, he never did reach his goal,
and only ever entered with monotype<0xFA>teams for 17 out of the 18 types.<0xFB>Maybe you want to take up the
challenge instead?
entries.french_reference:
Tu connais le
Panthéon ?\pC'est là qu'on entre quand on bat
la Ligue Pokémon !\pIl fut un temps où l'ancien Maître,
Artie, y était allé si souvent\lqu'il s'est fixé pour but d'y\lentrer avec une équipe de chaque\ltype.\pHélas, il n'a jamais atteint son
but : il n'y est entré qu'avec des\léquipes monotypes de 17 des 18\ltypes.\pPeut-être voudras-tu relever le
défi à sa place ?
entries.portuguese:
Conhece o Hall of Fame?<0xFB>É para lá que você vai ao
derrotar a Liga Pokémon!<0xFB>O antigo Campeão Artie foi lá
tantas vezes que decidiu<0xFA>criar uma meta: entrar<0xFA>com equipes de um só tipo,<0xFA>para cada tipo existente.<0xFB>Infelizmente, ele nunca atingiu
a meta, e só entrou com equipes<0xFA>monotipo de 17 dos 18 tipos.<0xFB>Talvez você queira aceitar o
desafio no lugar dele?

entries.english:
You're taking up the challenge?
Sweet!<0xFB>Bring on those victories!<0xFB>There are <0xFC>ÀÉ18<0xFC>ÀË types in total, and
you'll need to enter the Hall of<0xFA>Fame with teams for each one.<0xFB>Oh, and keep this in mind: if you
Mega Evolve a Pokémon, both the<0xFA>base species and Mega species will<0xFA>count towards the team type.<0xFB>So, let's say you want to use a
Mega Gyarados.<0xFB>In addition to a Water-type team,
you could use it on both Flying-<0xFA>and Dark-type teams!

Tu relèves le défi ?
Super !\pEnchaîne les victoires !\pIl y a {COLOR}É18{COLOR}Ë types au total et tu dois

Méga-Évoluer un Pokémon,\lL'espèce de base et la Méga\lcompteront pour le type de l'équipe.\pDisons que tu veux utiliser un
Méga-Léviator.\pEn plus d'une équipe Eau, tu peux
l'utiliser dans les équipes Vol et\lTénèbres !

terá que entrar no Hall of<0xFA>Fame com equipes de cada tipo.<0xFB>Ah, lembre-se: se fizer uma

entries.english:
Hey, kid!
Listen up.<0xFB>The road up ahead is fraught with
Trainers wanting to battle.<0xFB>Some people have even dubbed it
“Challenge Road”.<0xFB>But hey, I understand if you don't
want to battle them.<0xFB>So, using my amazing psychic
powers, I can teleport you to the<0xFA>other side for free!<0xFB>What do you say, are you in?
entries.french_reference:
Hé, gamin !
Écoute.\pLa route plus loin est pleine de
Dresseurs qui veulent se battre.\pCertains l'ont même appelée
«Route Défi».\pMais si tu ne veux pas les
combattre, je comprends.\pAvec mes incroyables pouvoirs
psychiques, je peux te téléporter\lgratuitement de l'autre côté !\pAlors, qu'en dis-tu, tu es partant ?
entries.portuguese:
Ei, criança! Escute bem.<0xFB>A estrada adiante está cheia de
Treinadores querendo batalhar.<0xFB>Alguns até a chamam de
“Challenge Road”.<0xFB>Mas eu entendo se você não
quiser enfrentá-los.<0xFB>Com meus incríveis poderes
psíquicos, posso teleportar você<0xFA>para o outro lado de graça!<0xFB>E então, topa?

entries.english: What do you say, should I teleport\nyou to Dresco Town?
entries.french_reference: Alors, je te téléporte à Dresco ?
entries.portuguese: E então, devo teleportar você\npara Dresco Town?

entries.english: Here we go!<0xFB>Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!
entries.french_reference: C'est parti !\pAbra, Kadabra, Symbios !
entries.portuguese: Lá vamos nós!<0xFB>Abra, Kadabra, Reuniclus!

entries.english: If you change your mind let\nme know.
entries.french_reference: Si tu changes d'avis,\ndis-le-moi.
entries.portuguese: Se mudar de ideia, me avise.

entries.english: Listen, pal, you're on Challenge\nRoad to train, yeah?
entries.french_reference: Hé, mec, tu es sur la Route\nDéfi pour t'entraîner, hein ?
entries.portuguese: Escuta, colega, veio treinar na\nChallenge Road, né?

entries.english: Oh, my bad, just ignore me then.
entries.french_reference: Oh, pardon, oublie-moi alors.
entries.portuguese: Ah, foi mal, então me ignore.

entries.english:
I thought so!<0xFB>I can tell you're a Trainer burning
with fiery passion.<0xFB>Well, I have this Pokémon here.<0xFB>It'd be perfect for a Trainer
like you.<0xFB>Why don't you defeat all of the
Trainers on Challenge Road and<0xFA>then come back here?<0xFB>I'll give it to you then, so make
sure you have space in your party!
entries.french_reference:
Je m'en doutais !\pJe vois que tu es un Dresseur
tout feu tout flamme.\pJ'ai ce Pokémon sous la main.\pIl serait parfait pour un
Dresseur comme toi.\pPourquoi ne bats-tu pas tous les
Dresseurs de la Route Défi et\lreviens ici ?\pJe te le donnerai, alors pense
à faire de la place dans l'équipe !
entries.portuguese:
Eu sabia!<0xFB>Vejo que você é um Treinador
ardendo de paixão.<0xFB>Bem, tenho um Pokémon aqui.<0xFB>Seria perfeito para um Treinador
como você.<0xFB>Por que não derrota todos os
Treinadores da Challenge Road<0xFA>e depois volta aqui?<0xFB>Aí eu dou ele a você, então
deixe espaço na sua equipe!

entries.english: I thought so!<0xFB>I can tell you're a Trainer burning\nwith fiery passion.<0xFB>Well, since you've defeated all of\nthe Trainers on this road, I'd say<0xFA>you earned this Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Je le savais !\pJe vois que tu es un Dresseur\nbrûlant d'une passion ardente.\pEt comme tu as battu tous les\nDresseurs de cette route, je dirais\lque tu as mérité ce Pokémon.
entries.portuguese: Eu sabia!<0xFB>Vejo que você é um Treinador\nardendo de paixão.<0xFB>Bem, como já derrotou todos os\nTreinadores desta estrada,<0xFA>diria que merece este Pokémon.

entries.english: But make space in your party for it\nfirst, yeah?
entries.french_reference: Mais garde une place dans l'équipe\navant, ok ?
entries.portuguese: Mas primeiro deixe espaço na sua\nequipe, tá?

entries.english: Take care of that <0xFD>Á,\nyeah?<0xFB>If you treat it well, it'll keep\nthat fiery passion of yours alive<0xFA>for sure!
entries.french_reference: Prends soin de ce {STR_VAR_1},\nd'accord ?\pSi tu le traites bien, il gardera\nta passion ardente en vie,\lc'est sûr !
entries.portuguese: Cuide bem desse <0xFD><0x02>, tá?<0xFB>Se o tratar bem, ele vai manter\nsua paixão ardente<0xFA>sempre acesa, com certeza!

entries.english: Oh, it's the Trainer burning with\nfiery passion!<0xFB>I bet the <0xFD>Á I gave you\nbefore is doing great, yeah?
entries.french_reference: Oh, voilà le Dresseur tout feu\ntout flamme !\pJe parie que le {STR_VAR_1} que je\nt'ai donné va super bien, hein ?
entries.portuguese: Ah, é o Treinador de paixão\nardente!<0xFB>Aposto que o <0xFD><0x02> que\ndei a você está muito bem, né?

entries.english: Welcome to Challenge Road!<0xFB>Before you can explore it, you'll\nhave to go through me!
entries.french_reference: Bienvenue sur la Route Défi !\pAvant de l'explorer, il va falloir\npasser par moi !
entries.portuguese: Bem-vindo à Challenge Road!<0xFB>Antes de explorá-la, vai ter\nque passar por mim!

entries.english: You're something else.
entries.french_reference: Tu es vraiment unique.
entries.portuguese: Você é fora de série.

entries.english: Challenge Road is a place where\nmany Trainers come to practice.
entries.french_reference: La Route Défi est un lieu où\nbeaucoup de Dresseurs s'entraînent.
entries.portuguese: Challenge Road é um lugar onde\nmuitos Treinadores vêm treinar.

entries.english: You're taking up the challenge, eh?\nI hope you healed up!
entries.french_reference: Tu relèves le défi, hein ?\nJ'espère que tu es soigné !
entries.portuguese: Vai encarar o desafio, é? Espero\nque tenha se curado!

entries.english: You're decent.
entries.french_reference: Pas mal.
entries.portuguese: Você é bom.

entries.english: All Pokémon have weaknesses.\nEven the strongest ones.<0xFB>That's why it's best to raise\nPokémon of different types.
entries.french_reference: Tous les Pokémon ont des\nfaiblesses, même les plus forts.\pC'est pour ça qu'il vaut mieux\nélever des Pokémon de divers types.
entries.portuguese: Todos os Pokémon têm fraquezas.\nAté os mais fortes.<0xFB>Por isso, é melhor criar Pokémon\nde tipos diferentes.

entries.english: Have you seen them Yellow Poké\nBalls lying around?<0xFB>If you beat me, I'll tell you what\nthey're for!
entries.french_reference: Tu as vu ces Poké Balls jaunes\nqui traînent par terre ?\pSi tu me bats, je te dirai à\nquoi elles servent !
entries.portuguese: Viu as Poké Balls amarelas\nespalhadas por aí?<0xFB>Se me vencer, conto para que\nservem!

entries.english: You done got me, and real good,\ntoo!
entries.french_reference: Bien joué, tu m'as vraiment\nlaminé !
entries.portuguese: Você me pegou, e pegou de\njeito!

entries.english: Them <0xFC>ÀÉYellow Poké Balls<0xFC>ÀË hold\nitems called Technical Machines.<0xFB>These <0xFC>ÀÉTM<0xFC>ÀËs can be used to teach\nyour Pokémon moves as many times<0xFA>as you want!
entries.french_reference: Ces {COLOR}ÉPoké Balls jaunes{COLOR}Ë contiennent\ndes objets appelés Capsules Tech.\pCes {COLOR}ÉCT{COLOR}Ë peuvent apprendre des\ncapacités à tes Pokémon autant\lde fois que tu veux !
entries.portuguese: Essas <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Poké Balls amarelas<0xFC><0x01><0x08> têm\nTechnical Machines.<0xFB>Essas <0xFC><0x01><0x06>TM<0xFC><0x01><0x08>s ensinam movimentos aos\nseus Pokémon quantas vezes<0xFA>você quiser!

entries.english: Did you know that moves can have\ndifferent categories?
entries.french_reference: Savais-tu que les capacités ont\ndifférentes catégories ?
entries.portuguese: Sabia que movimentos podem ter\ncategorias diferentes?

entries.english: These categories help determine\nhow your Pokémon uses its moves.
entries.french_reference: Ces catégories guident la façon\ndont ton Pokémon utilise ses coups.
entries.portuguese: As categorias definem como seu\nPokémon usa movimentos.

entries.english: A Pokémon's moves can be physical\nmoves or special moves.<0xFB>A high Attack stat makes physical\nmoves deal more damage, and a high<0xFA>Sp. Atk stat makes special moves<0xFA>deal more damage!
entries.french_reference: Les attaques d'un Pokémon peuvent\nêtre physiques ou spéciales.\pUne forte Attaque rend les coups\nphysiques plus puissants, et une\lforte Att Spé rend les attaques\lspéciales plus puissantes !
entries.portuguese: Os movimentos de um Pokémon\npodem ser físicos ou especiais.<0xFB>Ataque alto faz movimentos\nfísicos causarem mais dano, e<0xFA>Ataque Especial alto aumenta<0xFA>o dano dos especiais!

entries.english: Have you prepared your first two\nPokémon for this battle?
entries.french_reference: As-tu préparé tes deux premiers\nPokémon pour ce combat ?
entries.portuguese: Preparou seus dois primeiros\nPokémon para esta batalha?

entries.english: Drat!\nKelsey took up my second slot!
entries.french_reference: Zut !\nKelsey a pris ma place !
entries.portuguese: Droga! Kelsey tomou minha\nsegunda vaga!

entries.english: The Pokémon you send out in a\nDouble Battle will be the Pokémon<0xFA>in the top row of your Party List.<0xFB>If one of those two Pokémon has\nfainted, the second Pokémon to<0xFA>be sent out will come from the<0xFA>second row and so on!
entries.french_reference: Les Pokémon que tu envoies en\nCombat Duo sont ceux qui sont\len haut de la liste de ton équipe.\pSi l'un de ces deux Pokémon est\nK.O., le deuxième envoyé\lviendra de la deuxième ligne,\let ainsi de suite !
entries.portuguese: Os Pokémon usados numa Batalha\nDupla são os da<0xFA>primeira linha da equipe.<0xFB>Se um deles estiver nocauteado,\no segundo Pokémon enviado<0xFA>virá da segunda linha,<0xFA>e assim por diante!

entries.english: We're a team!\nWe camp and battle together!<0xFB>But we can't battle you when you\nonly have one Pokémon!
entries.french_reference: On est une équipe !\nOn campe et on se bat ensemble !\pMais on ne peut pas te combattre\nsi tu n'as qu'un Pokémon !
entries.portuguese: Somos uma equipe! Acampamos e\nbatalhamos juntos!<0xFB>Mas não podemos enfrentar você\nse só tem um Pokémon!

entries.english: We're a team!\nWe battle and picnic together!
entries.french_reference: On est une équipe !\nOn se bat et on pique-nique à deux !
entries.portuguese: Somos uma equipe! Batalhamos e\nfazemos piqueniques!

entries.english: As long as I lose with Chad, the\noutcome doesn't matter to me!
entries.french_reference: Tant que je perds avec Chad,\nle résultat m'importe peu !
entries.portuguese: Desde que perca com Chad, o\nresultado não importa!

entries.english: You sure have a keen eye for\npicking good Pokémon!

entries.english: I just picked up my Pokémon from\nthe Day Care.<0xFB>They're raring to go!
entries.french_reference: Je viens de récupérer mes Pokémon\nà la Pension.\pIls sont à fond !
entries.portuguese: Acabei de buscar meus Pokémon\nno Day Care.<0xFB>Eles estão cheios de energia!

entries.english: Raring to go"\nMore like medium rare!
entries.french_reference: À fond…\nPlutôt à point !
entries.portuguese: Cheios de energia<0xB0> Agora estão\nbem passados!

entries.english: Pokémon left in the Day Care get\nstronger as you travel.
entries.french_reference: Les Pokémon laissés à la Pension\ndeviendront plus forts en voyage.
entries.portuguese: No Day Care, Pokémon ganham\nforça enquanto você viaja.

entries.english: I'm looking for Hidden Grottos.\nHave you seen any?
entries.french_reference: Je cherche des Antres Cachés.\nTu en as vu ?
entries.portuguese: Estou procurando Hidden Grottos.\nViu algum?

entries.english: If I had caught a Pokémon in a\nHidden Grotto, I would've won!
entries.french_reference: Si j'avais attrapé un Pokémon dans\nun Antre Caché, j'aurais gagné !
entries.portuguese: Se tivesse pego um Pokémon num\nHidden Grotto, teria vencido!

entries.english: Keep an eye out for dark patches\nbetween trees.<0xFB>Those indicate that there is a\nhidden pathway there.
entries.french_reference: Cherche les zones sombres entre les\narbres.\pElles indiquent un chemin\ncaché.
entries.portuguese: Fique de olho nos trechos\nescuros entre as árvores.<0xFB>Eles indicam uma passagem\nescondida ali.

entries.english: Sometimes my shorts cause chafing\nwhile I run, but for the most part,<0xFA>they're delightfully comfy and<0xFA>easy to wear!
entries.french_reference: Parfois, mes shorts me frottent en\ncourant, mais la plupart du temps\lils sont super confortables\let faciles à porter !
entries.portuguese: Às vezes minha bermuda me assa\nenquanto corro, mas geralmente<0xFA>ela é muito confortável<0xFA>e fácil de vestir!

entries.english: Ow!\nMy legs are chafing!
entries.french_reference: Aïe !\nMes jambes frottent !
entries.portuguese: Ai! Minhas pernas estão assadas!

entries.english: Do you know about <0xFC>ÀÉTerrains<0xFC>ÀË?<0xFB>For the most part, they're special\nbattlefield effects that boost the<0xFA>power of certain moves used by<0xFA>Pokémon on the ground.
entries.french_reference: Tu connais les {COLOR}ÉTerrains{COLOR}Ë ?\pCe sont des effets de terrain\nqui boostent certaines attaques\ldes Pokémon\lau sol.
entries.portuguese: Conhece os <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Terrenos<0xFC><0x01><0x08>?<0xFB>Em geral, são efeitos especiais\ndo campo que aumentam o poder<0xFA>de certos movimentos usados<0xFA>por Pokémon no solo.

entries.english: Don't think you can get past me\nso easily.
entries.french_reference: Ne crois pas passer\nsi facilement.
entries.portuguese: Não pense que vai passar por\nmim tão fácil.

entries.english: At least I caught you before you\ncould get past me!
entries.french_reference: Au moins je t'ai attrapé avant que\ntu ne passes !
entries.portuguese: Pelo menos peguei você antes\nque pudesse passar!

entries.english: Whenever I hear a Trainer run by,\nI immediately look and catch them!<0xFB>It's those silent Trainers who walk\nby that give me difficulty"
entries.french_reference: Quand j'entends un Dresseur courir,\nje me tourne pour t'attraper !\pCeux qui marchent en silence sont\nles plus durs à coincer…
entries.portuguese: Quando ouço um Treinador\ncorrer, olho e o pego na hora!<0xFB>O difícil são os Treinadores que\npassam andando em silêncio<0xB0>

entries.english: Is your nature a match for mine?<0xFB>Let's synchronize in a beautiful\nbattle to find out!
entries.french_reference: Nos natures sont-elles compatibles?\pSynchronisons-nous dans un beau\ncombat pour le découvrir !
entries.portuguese: Sua natureza combina com a\nminha?<0xFB>Vamos sincronizar numa bela\nbatalha para descobrir!

entries.english: Even though Kirlia had Synchronize,\nturns out you're not my type"
entries.french_reference: Même avec Synchro, Kirlia n'a pas\nfait de toi mon type…
entries.portuguese: Mesmo com Synchronize de Kirlia,\nvocê não é do meu tipo<0xB0>

entries.english: When a Pokémon with <0xFC>ÀÉSynchronize<0xFC>ÀÇ\nleads the party, all Pokémon you<0xFA>find will have the same <0xFC>ÀÉnature<0xFC>ÀÇ as it!
entries.french_reference: Quand un Pokémon avec {COLOR}ÉSynchro{COLOR}Ç mène\nl'équipe, tous ceux que tu trouves\lont la même {COLOR}Énature{COLOR}Ç !
entries.portuguese: Com <0xFC><0x01><0x06>Synchronize<0xFC><0x01><0x04>, se o Pokémon\nliderar a equipe, os que achar<0xFA>terão a mesma <0xFC><0x01><0x06>natureza<0xFC><0x01><0x04> dele!

entries.english: Many call me a maniac, but I prefer\nthe term “enthusiast”.
entries.french_reference: On me dit maniaque, mais je\npréfère passionné.
entries.portuguese: Muitos me chamam de maníaco,\nmas prefiro “entusiasta”.

entries.english: You can beat me in battle, but\nyou'll never beat me in knowledge!
entries.french_reference: Tu peux me battre en combat, mais\njamais en savoir !
entries.portuguese: Pode me vencer em batalha, mas\nnunca em conhecimento!

entries.english: There is no room in my heart for\nanything but my bugs.<0xFB>Say, do you also notice a bug\nhiding in that girl's hair?
entries.french_reference: Mon cœur n'a de place que pour mes\ninsectes.\pDis, tu vois aussi un insecte caché\ndans les cheveux de cette fille ?
entries.portuguese: No meu coração só há espaço\npara meus insetos.<0xFB>Aliás, também notou um inseto\nescondido no cabelo dela?

entries.english: Two bridges"<0xFB>If you beat me, I'll tell you which\none gets you to the next route!
entries.french_reference: Deux ponts…\pSi tu me bats, je te dirai lequel\nmène à la route suivante !
entries.portuguese: Duas pontes<0xB0><0xFB>Se me vencer, conto qual delas\nleva à próxima rota!

entries.english: I guess I have to tell you now.
entries.french_reference: Je suppose que je dois te le dire.
entries.portuguese: Acho que agora preciso contar.

entries.english: The fact that you battled me means\nyou're going the right way.
entries.french_reference: Le fait que tu m'aies combattu veut\ndire que tu es sur la bonne voie.
entries.portuguese: Se me enfrentou, está no caminho\ncerto.

entries.english: Tee hee"<0xFB>If you took the bridge on the\nright, you must be looking<0xFA>for adventure!
entries.french_reference: Hihi…\pSi tu as pris le pont de droite,\nc'est que tu cherches\ll'aventure !
entries.portuguese: Hehe<0xB0><0xFB>Se pegou a ponte da direita,\ndeve estar procurando<0xFA>aventura!

entries.english: I hope I satisfied your craving!
entries.french_reference: J'espère t'avoir rassasié !
entries.portuguese: Espero ter satisfeito sua\nvontade!

entries.english: Unless you can Surf, going this\nway just leads to a dead end.
entries.french_reference: Sans Surf, ce chemin mène juste à\nun cul-de-sac.
entries.portuguese: Sem Surf, esse caminho só leva\na um beco sem saída.

entries.english: This is the only Route where a\nPokémon that appears at night<0xFA>will also appear in the early<0xFA>morning!
entries.french_reference: C'est la seule route où un Pokémon\nnocturne peut aussi apparaître\ltôt le matin,\lmême à l'aube !
entries.portuguese: Esta é a única rota onde um\nPokémon que aparece à noite<0xFA>também aparece<0xFA>de manhãzinha!

entries.english: If you wake up really early,\nyou'll hear Kricketot cries!
entries.french_reference: Si tu te lèves très tôt, tu\nentendras les Crikzik !
entries.portuguese: Se acordar bem cedo, vai ouvir\nos gritos de Kricketot!

entries.english: Kricketot must stay awake longer\nthan other nocturnal Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Les Crikzik doivent rester éveillés\nplus longtemps que les autres.
entries.portuguese: Kricketot deve dormir mais tarde\nque outros noturnos.

entries.english: I'm outside at all hours of the day\nsearching for rare bug Pokémon.
entries.french_reference: Je suis dehors à toute heure pour\nchercher des Pokémon insectes rares.
entries.portuguese: Procuro Pokémon Inseto raros a\nqualquer hora do dia.

entries.english: Hmm" I must not have searched\nhard enough.
entries.french_reference: Hmm…\nJe n'ai pas assez cherché.
entries.portuguese: Hmm<0xB0> Acho que não procurei o\nbastante.

entries.english: Like bird Pokémon, bug Pokémon\ngenerally change when the sun sets.
entries.french_reference: Comme les oiseaux, les insectes\nchangent souvent au crépuscule.
entries.portuguese: Como os pássaros, os Pokémon\nInseto mudam ao pôr do sol.

entries.english: When Smeargle swarm, they swarm\non this very route!
entries.french_reference: Quand les Queulorior essaiment,\nc'est sur cette route !
entries.portuguese: Quando Smeargle formam enxames,\né nesta rota!
